description: Defines template classes SharedPtrWrap and LockWrap for thread-safe shared pointer management and synchronized access to objects, including examples and detailed comments.

classes.name: SharedPtrWrap
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around std::shared_ptr that allows atomic-like access and modification.

classes.name: LockWrap
classes.description: A template class providing thread-safe access to an object of type T by locking on method calls.

methods.name: SharedPtrWrap::get
methods.description: Returns the current shared pointer atomically.

methods.name: SharedPtrWrap::set
methods.description: Sets a new shared pointer, returning the previous one.

methods.name: SharedPtrWrap::operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the shared object via shared pointer.

methods.name: LockWrap::operator->
methods.description: Returns a LockedPointer that manages locking for thread-safe access.

methods.name: LockWrap::getRecursionDepth
methods.description: Returns the current recursion depth of the recursive mutex.
